entries.description: and Allah testifies that the hypocrites are liars
entries.subject: and Allah

spans.text: And Allah knows that you are His Messenger, and Allah testifies that the hypocrites are liars.

[3] AR: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا۟ فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ EN: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand.
[They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them.
May Allah destroy them; how are they deluded?

entries.description: when it is said to them
entries.subject: when it

spans.text: [5] AR: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ لَوَّوْا۟ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ EN: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.

spans.text: [6] AR: سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ EN: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allah forgive them.

spans.text: [8] AR: يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعْنَآ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ ٱلْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا ٱلْأَذَلَّ ۚ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِۦ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ EN: They say, "If we return to al-Madinah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble."
And to Allah belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.
